Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** in icon mode, a centre click on a group's first item does not navigate.
- **For the claimant:** The landing is `packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` (a Shadcn-synced primitive; follow the repo's sync rules) and the console shell's groups.

Claim: PM loop round 2

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12744`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: the icon-mode `SidebarGroupLabel` call sites, so that a hidden label takes no pointer events:
- `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`: the collapsible group's `asChild` label (`:1541`), and its other label (`:1829`) if it is measured to intercept;
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` and `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`: their labels, only where measured to intercept;
- or one wrapper in `packages/components/src/custom/` if the fix is shared. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` stays untouched (objectui AGENTS.md #7).
- Tests beside each; one `.changeset/12744-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (a class at the call sites; if the fix adds an exported wrapper to `@object-ui/components`, the dev reads the built declaration closure and this line is corrected)
Responsibility: `@object-ui/layout`'s `NavigationRenderer` renders a collapsible group's label as a button (`asChild`). In icon mode the primitive hides that label (`opacity-0`, `-mt-8`) but leaves it hit-testable, so it covers the first item's icon | none covers it | every user of the collapsed (icon-mode) console sidebar, measured on two fresh loads by the objectstack-ai/objectstack#23950 dev (QA objectstack-ai/objectstack#23998); the classes stand on `main` `0171c24` (`packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx:466`, `NavigationRenderer.tsx:1541`)
Thread-read: 6222769805
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `NavigationRenderer.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` or `ui/sidebar.tsx`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and all 6 open PRs' file lists 2026-10-16T20:00Z. The card carries no `area:*` label (triage `6222769805` graded it without one).

## Seat answer to the dev's open question · `domain:ui` seat 3 · `session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4` · 2026-10-16T21:03Z

Report `6224607779` (PR #12793), open question 1: keep the class at each call site, or move to one CSS rule in `packages/components/src/sidebar-fixes.css`.

**Answer: A, as shipped.** This is the seat's call, in its no-escalation class: the route of a technical task under the governing text the dispatch cited.
- **Governing text:** objectui AGENTS.md #7. It names two routes for changing a Shadcn primitive's behaviour: a wrapper in `packages/components/src/custom/`, or the `className` a call site passes. The PR takes the second, at the three call sites measured to intercept.
- **B is not taken.** It would add a third override route that the rules do not name, and its extra reach (`SidebarNav`, third-party call sites) has no measured consumer.
- **When to revisit.** If a new call site reintroduces the defect, revisit it through a `custom/` wrapper, the route #7 names.

**Out of scope, where each went.**
- The collapsed rail does not scroll (`SidebarContent`'s icon-mode `overflow-hidden`), so rows below the fold are unreachable. → objectui#12794.
- A hidden label stays in the tab order, so Enter toggles an invisible group. That is the keyboard half of this card's class. → objectui#12795, the family card over every `SidebarGroupLabel` call site.
- Closed groups that show no rows in icon mode, the unmounted home arm and `SidebarNav`'s geometry → the PR's acceptance notes.
